import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int r, c, dis;
        Node(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static String s;
    static int n, n1, m, lim, tot, p;
    static int[][] a = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] b = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] d0 = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] f = new int[202][202];
    static int[][] d = new int[202][202];
    static int[] w = new int[202];
    static int[] h = new int[202];
    static int[] g = new int[203];
    static boolean t, flag;
    static boolean[][] ok = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] okb = new boolean[12][12];

    static void search(int x, int z) {
        if (x == n + 1) {
            p = z;
            flag = true;
            return;
        }
        int temp = n + 2;
        for (int y = 0; y <= n + 1; ++y) {
            if (d[x][y] < f[x][y]) {
                temp = Math.min(temp, h[y]);
                if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                    w[++tot] = y;
                    search(y, Math.min(z, f[x][y] - d[x][y]));
                    if ((!t) || (flag))
                        return;
                    w[tot--] = 0;
                }
            }
            if (d[y][x] > 0) {
                temp = Math.min(temp, h[y]);
                if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                    w[++tot] = -y;
                    search(y, Math.min(z, d[y][x]));
                    if ((!t) || (flag))
                        return;
                    w[tot--] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (temp + 1 != h[x]) {
            --g[h[x]];
            if (g[h[x]] == 0)
                t = false;
            h[x] = temp + 1;
            ++g[h[x]];
        }
    }

    static boolean improvable() {
        flag = false;
        p = n1;
        tot = 0;
        w[0] = 0;
        search(0, n1);
        return flag;
    }

    static void improve() {
        for (int x = 1; x <= tot; ++x) {
            if (w[x] > 0)
                d[Math.abs(w[x - 1])][w[x]] += p;
            else
                d[-w[x]][Math.abs(w[x - 1])] -= p;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        lim = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            s = line;
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                    q.add(he);
                } else if (ch != 'Y') {
                    ok[i][j] = true;
                    d0[i][j] = lim;
                    int k = ch - '0';
                    if (k > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++n;
                        f[0][n] = k;
                        n1 += k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // copy ok to okb
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            System.arraycopy(ok[i], 0, okb[i], 0, m + 1);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            s = line;
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y')
                    continue;
                int k = ch - '0';
                if (k > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++n;
                    f[n][m * m + 1] = k;
                }
            }
        }
        if (n != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int k = b[i][j];
                        f[k][n + 1] = f[k][m * m + 1];
                        f[k][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // BFS from Z cells to compute d0
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node he = q.poll();
            int i = he.r, j = he.c;
            d0[i][j] = he.dis;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int ni = i + dx[k];
                int nj = j + dy[k];
                if (ni >= 1 && ni <= m && nj >= 1 && nj <= m && ok[ni][nj]) {
                    Node e = new Node(ni, nj, he.dis + 1);
                    q.add(e);
                    ok[ni][nj] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        // BFS from each source cell
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0)
                    continue;
                // copy okb to ok
                for (int ii = 1; ii <= m; ++ii) {
                    System.arraycopy(okb[ii], 0, ok[ii], 0, m + 1);
                }
                ok[i][j] = false;
                Node he = new Node(i, j, 0);
                q.add(he);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    he = q.poll();
                    int x = he.r, y = he.c;
                    if (b[x][y] > 0 && he.dis <= d0[x][y]) {
                        f[a[i][j]][b[x][y]] = n1;
                    }
                    if (he.dis + 1 > lim || he.dis >= d0[x][y])
                        continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nx = x + dx[k];
                        int ny = y + dy[k];
                        if (nx >= 1 && nx <= m && ny >= 1 && ny <= m && ok[nx][ny]) {
                            Node e = new Node(nx, ny, he.dis + 1);
                            q.add(e);
                            ok[nx][ny] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        g[0] = n + 2;
        t = true;
        while (t && h[0] <= n + 2) {
            while (improvable())
                improve();
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            ans += d[i][n + 1];
        System.out.println(ans);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
